title: Signal
style: pop rock, synth, male vocals, raw, steady
lyrics:
[Verse]
AI tried to read it
System caught a snag
Spit out the RRRRRR
Red flag in the bag
Raw text bleedin' out
Friction on the wire
But a builder takes a spark and he turns it to a fire

[Pre-Chorus]
The signal's locked
The code is clear
In 336
There is no fear
From the vault to the wire
The stack is set
No walls in sight
No room for regret
Across the VPS
The path is wide
With nothing left to cast aside

[Chorus]
Oh
Corey
The frequency hums your name
The ZYNTHIO arc
A different game
No lookin' back
Just the forward drive
Keep the signal burnin'
Keep it alive
From the side bar shadows
The message plays
A steady beat through the digital haze

[Outro]
Deploy it now
Let the system run
The work is heavy
But the day is won
Corey
The rhythm's in your hand
